responsibility: Defines the abstract derive-expansion framework used for builtin Rust #[derive] support. The DeriveVisitor base class constrains derivation to structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions, owns the source location and AST::Builder used to synthesize new items, exposes the static dispatch entry point, and finalizes all unrelated AST visitor methods so concrete derive implementations only provide the four shape-specific handlers relevant to trait generation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the abstract DeriveVisitor framework and constrains derive support to structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions. Unlike rust-derive.cc, which performs builtin derive dispatch, this header supplies the reusable base-class contract that concrete derive files such as rust-derive-clone.* and rust-derive-copy.* implement.
